g.text: Additional detail only; the complete 26 s acquisition is retained separately. Exact bounded C++ Stribeck compensator on both platforms.

g.text: Recorded voltage/timestamps, quantized PWM/encoders and the same 50 ms filter; each controller uses its own encoder feedback.
